name: Is damaged board replacement covered by home insurance?

mainEntity.name: Is damaged board replacement covered by home insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether damaged board replacement is covered by home insurance depends entirely on your specific policy and the cause of the damage. Typically, sudden and accidental damage, such as from a storm or a burst pipe, might be covered. Damage resulting from neglect, wear and tear, or ongoing issues like long-term water leaks or dry rot is generally not. We recommend reviewing your policy details and contacting your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage options. This is an important Contextual Relevance point for financial planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insurance coverage depends on your policy and damage cause. Sudden damage may be covered; neglect or wear and tear usually are not. Check your policy.
